class.name: TileMapPathGraphOptions
class.brief_description: Settings of a [TileMapPathGraph]: neighbors, corner cutting, costs and blocked cells.

members.member: Name of the [TileSet] custom data layer that marks blocked tiles. Its value is read as [bool]: [code]true[/code] blocks the cell. Empty means no tile is blocked by data. An unknown name prints a warning at [method TileMapPathGraph.update_all].

Name of the [TileSet] custom data layer with the cost of entering a cell, read as [float]. A value of [code]0[/code] or less means "not set" (unpainted custom data is [code]0[/code]) and uses [member default_cost]. Empty means every cell costs [member default_cost]. An unknown name prints a warning at [method TileMapPathGraph.update_all].
Cost of entering a cell without a cost value, including walkable empty cells. Can't be negative.

When corner steps are allowed, with [member neighbor_mode] set to [constant NEIGHBOR_MODE_SIDES_AND_CORNERS]. The default [constant AStarGrid2D.DIAGONAL_MODE_ONLY_IF_NO_OBSTACLES] never cuts the corner of a blocked cell. [b]Note:[/b] Applies to the grid backend (square and diamond isometric maps). On the graph backend only stacked and stairs isometric layouts have corners; they are always connected.
If [code]true[/code], cells without a tile inside the used rect of the layer are blocked. If [code]false[/code], they are walkable at [member default_cost].
Which neighbors a cell is connected to. See [enum NeighborMode].

constants.constant: Steps only across the sides of a cell: 4 neighbors on square and isometric maps, 6 on half-offset and hexagon maps.
Steps across sides and corners: 8 neighbors on square and isometric maps, controlled by [member diagonal_mode]. Half-offset and hexagon maps have no corner neighbors and keep 6.
Represents the size of the [enum NeighborMode] enum.
